profile.headline: Web Developer and Social Account Manager at The MediaBeast Marketing Group LLC
profile.jobTitle: Web Developer and Social Account Manager
profile.summary:
Sales and Marketing Specialist with over 5 years experience in internal and external sales.

Specialties: Senior Living with focus on Assisted Living and Memory Care, Start-Up, Director of Sales, Event Coordinator, Community Liaison, Educator and Care Consultant for Alzheimer's and demenita care, Marketing and Advertising Management

positions.title: Web Developer and Social Account Manager
positions.description:
Web Designer specializing in WordPress (HTML, CCS, and Coding)

* Responsive web design for new site builds 
* Rebuild existing sites to increase marketability and search engine optimization
* Custom-build sites for functionality that increase online conversions and meet clients' goals 
* Designing the website's visual imagery and ensuring it's in line with company brand/image
* Edit and Proofreading content and making changes where necessary
Clients Include: Legal, B2B, and Service Industry 

Social Media Account Manager

* Work with clients to create a social media strategy that collaborates with marketing and advertising campaigns
* Create timely and engaging content optimized for site conversions
* Analyze and report social media actions on a monthly basis for successes and new opportunities.
* Create engaging and professional visuals that reflect client and their brand (Customize social media pages (ex. Facebook, Twitter, Google+, YouTube), develop supporting offline collateral, create original content, etc).
* Stay current with social media trends and tools – includes attending networking and educational events, reading blogs, and listening to podcasts.
Clients Include: Legal, Home Remodeling, and Senior Living

positions.title: Sales and Marketing Director
positions.description:
Sales and Marketing Director for Horizon Bay Memory Care By the Bay, a new start up Alzheimer's Facility 

Executed Public Relations pre-opening campaign with local media outlets, social media, and local community organizations, which included:

Current Accomplishments:

-Highest Net Gain for company in August 2012

-Consistent Net Gain month to month

- Training, Coaching, and Mentoring sales/marketing team 

-Overseeing all Media Placement including: Direct Mail, Print, Social MEdia, SEM/SEO.

positions.title: Community Relations Director
positions.description: Marketing and Sales Director responsible for growing community occupancy and revenue, through internal and external sales efforts.  Proactive problem solver in tune to emotional and situational needs of families and prospective residents.  Superlative communicator in developing successful relationships with leads and professional referral sources.

positions.title: Account Executive
positions.description: Business Development Specialist responsible in generating new business through effective cold-calling, prospecting of sales leads, and networking initiatives, while growing existing business revenue through service and expansion of current clientele. Negotiate rates consistent with company’s operating and budget goals
